name: ribbon
description: A slim band above the prompt: how much of your 5-hour and 7-day usage is left, when each resets, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold with what the next message costs.

usage.title: Usage figure
usage.description: left shows how much of each window is left; used shows how much is spent, as Claude Code's own rate-limit figures do

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: The band's text size on desktop, VS Code and mobile; the terminal has one size and ignores it. Larger sizes stack the band sooner so nothing clips
